item.title: Masterpieces from Agnes Gund’s Collection Will Headline Christie’s May Marquee Auctions
item.description: The sale of works by Rothko, Twombly and Joseph Cornell posthumously continues her legacy of charitable giving.

item.title: From Soil to Still: The Master of Botanicals Rethinking Sustainability in Premium Spirits
item.description: Alessandro Garneri has spent nearly two decades shaping the botanical foundations of some of the world’s most recognized spirits. In this Expert Insights Q&A, Garneri explores why soil health, traceability and climate resilience are not separate from craftsmanship, but essential to preserving the character and continuity of iconic spirits for generations to come.

item.title: Mia Westerlund Roosen’s Ongoing Material Inquiry
item.description: Challenging boundaries between form, expression and emotion, her tactile, organic and sometimes disturbingly sensual sculptures invite deep engagement.

item.title: Francesco Bonami’s Case Against Trend-Chasing in the Museum Business
item.description: Under Bonami’s direction, By Art Matters in Hangzhou, China, has embraced a curatorial model that favors instinct, experimentation and intellectual risk.

item.title: Fei-Fei Li and Andrej Karpathy Back a New A.I. Use Case: Simulating Human Behavior
item.description: Backed by Fei-Fei Li and Andrej Karpathy, Simile raises $100 million to use A.I. simulations that predict analyst questions and business outcomes.

item.title: In Qatar’s Zekreet Desert, Sheikh Mohammed Rashid Al-Thani Welcomes All
item.description: Rahaal is a transitory desert museum grounded in Qatari traditions of spontaneous hospitality, nomadic movement, shared spaces and collective experiences.

item.title: Meet the Collector: Marques Redd On Stewardship, Memory and Collecting Beyond Value
item.description: The Redd Family Collection is, he tells Observer, "a river of memory carrying Black artistic vision forward into the present.”

item.title: Why London’s Top Restaurants Are Setting Their Sights on New York
item.description: A number of successful London-based eateries are soon opening in New York, from famous Indian restaurants to a renowned cheese conveyor belt spot.

item.title: Sargent’s Daughters’ Allegra LaViola Is Playing the Long Game
item.description: "I work for the artists,” she tells Observer. "If the artist is happy and the work is strong, everything else follows.”

item.title: The 2026 Aston Martin DBX S: Exceptional Performance, Uninspired Aesthetics
item.description: The DBX S fits into the Aston Martin line loyally, but only time will tell if it, too, will rise to the top of the sales charts, as crossovers and SUVs have almost everywhere else.
